question: Should Workspaces expose `bus:pubsub` as a supported custom-widget capability with these version-1 message names, same-tab semantics, and resource limits?
rationale: This permanently expands what untrusted agent-authored iframe code may ask the trusted parent to do; code review can validate the mechanics, but maintainers must own the product, security, and compatibility contract.

options.title: Sponsor and prove the API
options.body: Approve the proposed capability contract subject to exact-head real browser proof of routing and lifecycle behavior.

options.title: Defer custom-widget coordination
options.body: Keep the existing isolated bridge contract and pause or close this PR until widget pub/sub is an accepted product priority.

recommendation.title: Sponsor and prove the API
recommendation.body: Approve the proposed capability contract subject to exact-head real browser proof of routing and lifecycle behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The current Workspaces custom-widget bridge and sandbox capability model were introduced through their merged foundation work.
